summary: This RFC adds an authentication trailer to OSPFv3, so packets can be authenticated without relying on IPsec, which was the only option before and can be hard to configure and maintain. It brings OSPFv3 closer to the approach used by other routing protocols. It was replaced by RFC 7166.

eli5.summary: Routers used to need a complicated lock to prove messages were real. This adds a simpler stamp on each message instead. Later, a newer RFC replaced it.
